config system interface
    edit "wan1"
        set vdom "root"
        set mode dhcp
        set allowaccess ping https ssh
        set type physical
        set role wan
        set snmp-index 1
        config ipv6
            set ip6-mode dhcp
            set ip6-allowaccess ping
        end
    next
    edit "wan2"
        set vdom "root"
        set mode dhcp
        set allowaccess ping https ssh
        set type physical
        set role wan
        set snmp-index 2
        config ipv6
            set ip6-mode dhcp
            set ip6-allowaccess ping
        end
    next
    edit "dmz"
        set vdom "root"
        set ip 198.51.100.1 255.255.255.128
        set allowaccess ping https fabric
        set type physical
        set role dmz
        set snmp-index 3
    next
    edit "internal1"
        set vdom "root"
        set type physical
        set snmp-index 4
    next
    edit "internal2"
        set vdom "root"
        set type physical
        set snmp-index 5
    next
    edit "internal3"
        set vdom "root"
        set type physical
        set snmp-index 6
    next
    edit "internal4"
        set vdom "root"
        set type physical
        set snmp-index 7
    next
    edit "internal5"
        set vdom "root"
        set type physical
        set snmp-index 8
    next
    edit "a"
        set vdom "root"
        set type physical
        set snmp-index 9
    next
    edit "b"
        set vdom "root"
        set type physical
        set snmp-index 10
    next
    edit "modem"
        set vdom "root"
        set mode pppoe
        set status down
        set type physical
        set snmp-index 11
    next
    edit "naf.root"
        set vdom "root"
        set type tunnel
        set src-check disable
        set snmp-index 12
    next
    edit "l2t.root"
        set vdom "root"
        set type tunnel
        set snmp-index 13
    next
    edit "ssl.root"
        set vdom "root"
        set type tunnel
        set alias "Agentless VPN interface"
        set snmp-index 14
    next
    edit "internal"
        set vdom "root"
        set ip 203.0.113.99 255.255.255.0
        set allowaccess ping https ssh fabric
        set type hard-switch
        set stp enable
        set role lan
        set snmp-index 15
    next
    edit "default-mesh"
        set vdom "root"
        set type vap-switch
        set role lan
        set snmp-index 16
    next
    edit "fortilink"
        set vdom "root"
        set fortilink enable
        set ip 203.0.113.254 255.255.255.0
        set allowaccess ping fabric
        set type aggregate
        set member "a" "b"
        set lldp-reception enable
        set lldp-transmission enable
        set snmp-index 17
        set switch-controller-nac "fortilink"
        set switch-controller-dynamic "fortilink"
    next
    edit "_default"
        set vdom "root"
        set ip 203.0.113.253 255.255.255.0
        set allowaccess ping fabric
        set alias "_default.fortilink"
        set snmp-index 18
        set auto-auth-extension-device enable
        set switch-controller-feature default-vlan
        set interface "fortilink"
        set vlanid 1
    next
    edit "quarantine"
        set vdom "root"
        set ip 203.0.113.252 255.255.255.0
        set description "Quarantine VLAN"
        set alias "quarantine.fortilink"
        set security-mode captive-portal
        set replacemsg-override-group "auth-intf-quarantine"
        set device-identification enable
        set snmp-index 19
        set switch-controller-access-vlan enable
        set switch-controller-feature quarantine
        set color 6
        set interface "fortilink"
        set vlanid 4093
    next
    edit "voice"
        set vdom "root"
        set description "Fortivoice VLAN"
        set alias "voice.fortilink"
        set device-identification enable
        set snmp-index 20
        set switch-controller-feature voice
        set interface "fortilink"
        set vlanid 4091
    next
    edit "video"
        set vdom "root"
        set description "Forticamera VLAN"
        set alias "video.fortilink"
        set device-identification enable
        set snmp-index 21
        set switch-controller-feature video
        set interface "fortilink"
        set vlanid 4090
    next
    edit "rspan"
        set vdom "root"
        set ip 203.0.113.251 255.255.255.0
        set description "Sniffer VLAN"
        set alias "rspan.fortilink"
        set snmp-index 22
        set switch-controller-traffic-policy "sniffer"
        set switch-controller-feature rspan
        set interface "fortilink"
        set vlanid 4092
    next
    edit "onboarding"
        set vdom "root"
        set description "NAC Onboarding VLAN"
        set alias "onboarding.fortilink"
        set security-mode captive-portal
        set device-identification enable
        set snmp-index 23

        set switch-controller-feature nac
        set interface "fortilink"
        set vlanid 4089
    next
    edit "nac_segment"

        set snmp-index 24
        set switch-controller-feature nac-segment
        set interface "fortilink"
        set vlanid 4088
    next
    edit "host01"
        set vdom "root"
        set ip 203.0.113.249 255.255.255.0
        set allowaccess ping https ssh
        set description "port-desc-02"
        set device-identification enable
        set role lan
        set snmp-index 25
        set interface "fortilink"
        set vlanid 100
    next
    edit "host02"

        set device-identification enable

    edit "host03"
